officialLinks.label: Calculating GPA; grade values; precision; careers

helpIntro: MIT uses a 5.0 scale. Enter MIT units and final grades; A=5, B=4, C=3, D=2, F/O=0. The result is a planning estimate.
helpNote: For standard upper-level undergraduate work. First-year fall has no GPA; graduate records are separate. The shared calculator displays three decimals; MIT rounds the official GPA to one decimal. Repeat Impact is unavailable because MIT counts every graded attempt.
helpExample: A 12-unit A earns 60 grade points; a 12-unit B earns 48. Together, 108 ÷ 24 = 4.5.

gradeExplanations.A+: MIT internal modifier; same 5 points as A.
gradeExplanations.A-: MIT internal modifier; same 5 points as A.
gradeExplanations.B+: MIT internal modifier; same 4 points as B.
gradeExplanations.B-: MIT internal modifier; same 4 points as B.
gradeExplanations.C+: MIT internal modifier; same 3 points as C.
gradeExplanations.C-: MIT internal modifier; same 3 points as C.
gradeExplanations.D: D = 2 points per MIT unit on standard grading.
gradeExplanations.F: F = zero points; its units still count in GPA.
gradeExplanations.O: Unexcused absence O = zero points; confirm if later changed to OX.
gradeExplanations.P: Pass is excluded from MIT GPA.
gradeExplanations.S: Transfer credit S is excluded from MIT GPA.
gradeExplanations.SA: Completed doctoral thesis notation is excluded.
gradeExplanations.T: Temporary notation; include the final grade only when recorded.
gradeExplanations.OX: Excused absence: excluded pending final grade.
gradeExplanations.J: Ongoing work: excluded until completion; earlier J units may later take final grade.
gradeExplanations.U: Uncompleted thesis: excluded pending final outcome.
gradeExplanations.DN: First-year or Flexible P/NR no-record D; excluded from MIT GPA.
gradeExplanations.FN: First-year or Flexible P/NR no-record F; excluded from MIT GPA.
gradeExplanations.ON: First-year no-record O; excluded; review the internal grade report.
gradeExplanations.OXN: First-year no-record OX; excluded; review the internal grade report.
gradeExplanations.PE: Emergency alternate pass grade; excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.NE: Emergency alternate no-record grade; excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.IE: Emergency incomplete; excluded unless a later final letter grade is assigned.

specialTypes.note: These do not enter MIT GPA.

specialTypes.note: Fall/IAP has no GPA; spring ABC/NR requires separate review.

repeatPolicy.note: Enter both graded attempts as separate completed courses; both contribute to GPA, but this tool does not decide repeat eligibility or degree credit.
